name: Cycle of connected circles
what: On a plain page, a coloured circle with a word in it fades in, a thin line is drawn around a big circle and the next circles fade in one after another just before the line reaches them, until four circles are linked in a cycle; the cycle then pushes in toward the viewer.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f10 the first circle fades in at the top (slow start); f10-f149 a thin line is drawn around a big circle at a steady pace (about 35 f for each circle); f32-f42, f67-f77, f103-f113 the next circles fade in (linear, 10 f each) just before the line reaches them; f157-f169 the whole cycle pushes in toward the viewer (accelerating)

tracks.name: first circle
tracks.what: the top circle and its text fade in

tracks.name: line
tracks.what: a thin line is drawn clockwise around the big circle, passing behind the circles

tracks.name: next circles
tracks.what: circles 2, 3 and 4 fade in, each just before the line reaches it (f32, f67, f103)

tracks.name: push in
tracks.what: the whole cycle scales up about 8 % toward the viewer, still speeding up when the clip ends
